reviews.title: Omg what a rip off!
reviews.comment:
As the title says rip off. The price  feels really bad. I really wanted this drive. And I spent $2700 on it. There's no reason in the world. This drive should cost that much. But welcome to AI pricing normal consumers out from buying these items at reasonable prices. 

So I would have reviewed this drive with 5 stars, but I had to take off a star for the price. The performance of this drive is outstanding as well as the space. It has given me on my computer. I would say a fair price for the drive would be a $1000. And then I would have gave it 5 stars And posted  without this title. That I gave this review.
reviews.author: MarkR
